topic: Stegosaurus did not have two brains
script: Stegosaurus did not have a second brain in its hips. That old idea came from a large space found in its hip bones. Today, scientists think the space held something else, possibly an energy store like birds have. Its real brain was small for its size. Even so, small-brained dinosaurs thrived for well over 150 million years. Stegosaurus fossils have been found in the western United States and Portugal. Follow DinoBytes for more prehistoric facts.
